body:
Banxa is an Australian exchange that supports the purchase of cryptocurrencies for users located in Australia.

Payment methods include POLi Bank Transfer at 1% fees and Newsagent Cash Deposit at 3% fees.

Banxa can be contacted at support@banxa.
